card.name: The word see in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The word "see" right after an opening bracket or parenthesis, where a drug label points the reader to another section, such as Warnings, Contraindications or Adverse Reactions.

modes.label: Bracketed cross-reference
modes.description: "see" opens a square-bracket pointer to a numbered label section, as in modern-format labels.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients [<<see>> Description ( 11 )] .

modes.label: Parenthetical cross-reference
modes.description: "see" opens a round-bracket pointer to a section name in capital letters, as in older-format labels.
modes.example: WARNINGS ETHAMOLlN Injection should be used in pregnant women only when clearly needed (<<see>> PRECAUTIONS).

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says "see" another section for more information.
